test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1a530cd9eab5e708da84009916f2610136c269d3d17e69ed431c95c82a0b5c5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1edef6a66abc50855b0ec5ec8634c7c998a3c2b5d1e4800296f4d4b94ef8013a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

Top 2 corner letters are interchanging their position with each other.

Bottom-right, Bottom-middle, middle and Top-middle letters are shifting their position in clockwise direction.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

Top 2 Top-right and top-middle letters are shifting their position in anticlockwise direction.

Remaining all 4 letters are shifting their position in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d93997666191c04773d06f8fd12c62d47dae90927005cae84b711ff8560d843.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af1e8115ce51528197a71e9c043419338b77d0a68f99e8cf8dd0acf9d0363a7b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
